jobs.title: Project Manager (Consumer Hardware)
jobs.description: Requires 2+ years of experience. 2–3 years+ of technical/multidisciplinary project management experience (software, hardware, mechanics) or a proven track record leading projects (e.g., complex production, infrastructure, or military tech roles) Basic knowledge in electronics and mechanics Willingness to work with China and US time zones (including early hours) and travel to China (~3–4 times/year)
